author: Tsquared44
quote: Giving it a 1 because this is not the GTA Ive grown to love and support since I was 10 years old. This isnt it. This is some hodgepodge cooked empty soul ****, lost to the golden developers who made this franchise what it was. The mechanics, bugs, low fps drops in semi bulky areas is nothing shy of a downgrade. After all the hype we get chores, dragging gameplay that honestly made me close my eyes the first day after taking off from work. This hit me like the MCC by 343 industries. Was so excited to play and it was a mess, vision was all over the place and buggy to heck. Couldnt even get a game after waiting 10 years for the installment. This drop is just like that and its made for the modern day audience if you have long hair and lipstick. Its politcally injected and this shouldnt be a place to bring your culture war. If it was in opposition these same critics would be blasting scores left and right, especially if it was from an eastern developer. Its not right and this is what happens when you cant stand the core audience your making a game for. I will sell this game to an online monkey because the no refund policy and snakeyness from rockstar holding off on too much gameplay and low FPS right before release to bag a preoder, knowing full well it was digital only and only on playstation, giving them the best chance to block returns. Not worth your time here if your a classic GTA player

author: Tsquared44
quote: Forza Horizon delivers an impressive open-world racing experience, combining exceptional vehicle modeling, beautiful environments, and an extensive automotive collection. However, beneath its remarkable presentation lies a formula that has become increasingly repetitive and predictable. The overly forgiving progression, limited sense of accomplishment, and lack of meaningful innovation prevent it from reaching the heights of a truly exceptional racing title. While the driving mechanics remain enjoyable, the experience often prioritizes accessibility and spectacle over depth and genuine progression. A technically accomplished racer, but one that falls short of its full potential compared to other installments of the past. Still a fun enough installment driving arojnd Japan!.

author: Tsquared44
quote: Loved every bit of this game and the connection between both protagonists. Its an unforgetable journey and another bombshell coming from eastern development. A beautiful story of AI and human going through an adventure together learning and understanding eachother. Combat is very unique and thrilling, world building is fairly linear like dead space style but does it well enough where its not an issue as there is good enough density of enemies. Think anyone looking for a scifi epic with a great storyline should give this one a try!.

author: Tsquared44
quote: The Legend of Zeld Ocarina of Time is nothing short of a masterpiece of nostalgia for me. This remake is a monumental achievement from the changes its underwent compared to the original. Its extraordinary world-building, unforgettae musical compositions,and meticulously crafted environments establish an atmosphere of wonder, mystery, and adventure that few games have ever managed to replicate. Just finished last night and if you loved the original this is one you need to come back to!.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Tsquared44
quote: Phantom Blade Zero is exceptional. The combat is incredibly fluid, visceral, and meticulously choreographed, with an artistic direction that perfectly captures the brutality and elegance of martial arts. The dark atmosphere, intricate environments, and cinematic presentation give it an identity that feels refreshingly distinct from the countless generic action titles flooding the industry. There's a remarkable level of craftsmanship here, particularly in the animations, weapon variety, and overall visual fidelity. If the complete experience maintains this level of quality, Phantom Blade Zero could easily establish itself as one of the finest action games of this generation. A genuinely ambitious title that deserves the attention it's receiving.

author: Tsquared44
quote: Veilguard is a disappointing departure from what made the franchise special. While the visuals are impressive and combat can be entertaining, the shallow dialogue, inconsistent writing, and lack of meaningful choices undermine the experience. The characters often feel overly sanitized, and the darker, mature atmosphere of previous entries is noticeably absent. It's a decent action RPG, but a mediocre Dragon Age game that sacrifices much of its identity for mainstream appeal.
